from: August book, night 15 (Blessed Be the Lord’s Name)
p1: In the land of Uz lived a good man named Job. He loved the Lord. Job had seven sons and three daughters.
Job had many sheep, camels and oxen. Early each morning, he gave gifts to the Lord for his children.
Then a very hard day came. Job’s animals were taken, and his children died. Job’s heart hurt so much.
p2: Job bowed down to the ground and worshipped the Lord. He said, “The Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away. Blessed be the name of the Lord.” Job knew every good thing came from the Lord. So he kept loving Him.
Every good thing we have is a gift from Heavenly Father. Tonight, hug your family and say, “Thank you, Heavenly Father.”
old: One day, hard things began to happen to Job. He lost his animals, and then his big house was gone too. Soon after, Job did not feel well at all.
Job was very sad. So many good things had gone away, and he didn’t understand why.
But even with his heavy heart, Job did something wonderful. He bowed down and said, “I will still trust Heavenly Father.”
Job didn’t stop loving Heavenly Father, even when life was hard. He held onto his faith like a strong little anchor. Trusting Heavenly Father in hard times is one of the bravest things we can do.
